sloka: इष्टामिव वरां नारीमवगाह्य दशाननः ।स तस्याः पुलिने रम्ये नानामुनिनिषेविते ।। ७.३१.२४ ॥
transliteration: iṣṭāmiva varāṁ nārīmavagāhya daśānanaḥ ।sa tasyāḥ puline ramye nānāmuniniṣevite ।। 7.31.24 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, having entered the Narmada as if embracing a beloved woman, then sat on her beautiful sandbank, which was frequented by various sages.
translations.hindi: निशाचरों से सत्क्रारित हो लङ्का नगरी में जा पहुँचा । इतने में कामरूपिणी भयङ्कर राक्षसी
